It is the state’s official counselling authority. The counselling process for NEET UG 2024 ended on December 4, 2024. This included the Special Stray Vacancy Round. No further rounds were announced after this date. The Special Stray Vacancy Round was the final phase of the counselling. It started on November 24 2024, with the release of the seat matrix. The round continued till December 4, 2024. It gave candidates a last chance to secure admission to medical and dental colleges. After this round, the counselling process for 2024 was officially closed. Rajasthan NEET UG Counselling Before this, the registration and choice filling for the Stray Vacancy Round were made from October 24 to October 27, 2024. The seat allotment results were declared on October 30, 2024. Selected candidates had to report to colleges and pay fees between November 4 and November 5, 2024. The timings were from 9 AM to 5 PM. 21 Aug ’24 Rajasthan NEET Counselling 2024 Round 1 Registration Earlier, the Rajasthan NEET 2024 counselling had three main rounds. Round 1 was held from August 16 to September 5, 2024. Round 2 took place from September 8 to October 5, 2024. Round 3 was conducted from October 8 to October 23, 2024. These rounds helped candidates secure seats in medical and dental colleges based on their NEET scores and choices. The process ensured fair and transparent seat allocation for students in Rajasthan. NEET UG Counselling Rajasthan NEET UG Counselling Eligibility Criteria Candidates must meet specific eligibility conditions to apply for Rajasthan NEET UG Counselling. These rules ensure that only qualified students are admitted to medical and dental colleges in Rajasthan. Below are the details: Nationality and Domicile Candidates must be Indian citizens. They should also have a valid Rajasthan domicile certificate. NEET Qualification Candidates must have appeared for the NEET exam and scored the qualifying marks. Only NEET-qualified candidates can apply for counselling. Age Limit As of December 31, 2024, candidates must be at least 17 years old. This is a mandatory requirement. Academic Qualifications Candidates must have passed Class 12 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English as compulsory subjects. They must also meet the minimum percentage criteria: General Category : 50% aggregate marks. Reserved Category (SC/ST/OBC) : 40% aggregate marks. Unreserved PwD Category : 45% aggregate marks. Eligibility for Round 2 and Later Rounds For Round 2 and subsequent rounds, only the following candidates can apply: Those who did not join the allotted college in earlier rounds. Those who were not allotted any seats in previous rounds. Rajasthan NEET Counselling 2024: Seat Allocation The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) handles MBBS and BDS seat distribution in Rajasthan. Seats are divided into the All India Quota (AIQ) and State Quota. Some seats are for students from all over India, while the rest are reserved for Rajasthan candidates. The counselling schedule, including registration dates, choice filling, and seat allotment rounds, is published on the official Rajasthan NEET counselling website. Is there a separate registration process for Rajasthan NEET counselling? Yes, candidates must register separately for Rajasthan NEET counselling on the official state counselling portal, even if they have registered for All India Quota (AIQ) counselling. Registration involves filling out personal and academic details and paying the required fees. What documents are required for Rajasthan NEET counselling? Candidates must submit documents such as NEET scorecard, Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, domicile certificate, ID proof, and category certificate (if applicable). A complete list is available on the official counselling website. Can I participate in Rajasthan NEET counselling if I am from another state? Rajasthan NEET counselling is only for candidates meeting the state’s domicile requirements. However, candidates from other states can apply under the All India Quota or for seats in private colleges. What is the fee structure for Rajasthan NEET counselling? The counselling fee varies based on the candidate’s category (General, OBC, SC/ST). The exact fee details are provided on the official Rajasthan NEET counselling portal during registration.
